title: Fairy and the Cursed Tower
description: A pink-winged fairy in ornate armor stands on a stone platform beside an open magical book emitting pink flames and black smoke. Behind her, a tall crumbling clock tower rises from turbulent waters, its cracked facade revealing glowing mechanisms and floating orbs while ghostly hands emerge from the waves under a blood-red eclipsed sun and stormy purple sky.
prompt: A winged fairy in pink and gold armor stands on a rocky platform in a turbulent sea, looking at an open book emitting pink fire and black smoke. In the background a tall crumbling clock tower with glowing mechanisms and floating orbs rises from the water, ghostly hands reaching from the waves. Dramatic red eclipsed sun in a purple stormy sky with lightning, dark fantasy surreal scene.
